definition_or_requirement: Define the target source slot S_tau_ac(k,a) := P_ac[Phi_tau_eff,A_tau,Theta_tau_ac,C_rec](k,a), where P_ac is an unfilled acoustic projection operator.
Supply endpoint-blind effective potential entering the recombination-era acoustic driving term.
Supply endpoint-blind amplitude normalization for relative peak-height support.
Supply reduced photon-baryon oscillator response or Green-function rule driven by S_tau_ac.
Supply Tau-source coupling law and sign convention relative to baryon loading.
Map S_tau_ac into predicted ell/value/uncertainty rows only after the source and response dependencies are derived.
Accepted null-response control may replace a prediction only if it has matching domain, convention, and endpoint-blind provenance.
Score may be attempted only after all Tau prediction or null-response rows are accepted endpoint-blind.
